text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is entering its final stretch. 
With the Keeneland Cup drawing near, we 
are truly at the climax, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Which is precisely why!!
choice_data_list: Let's play to our hearts' content today!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I happen to know the perfect words 
for a time like this, taught to me by a 
certain tempest.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, could it be...

text_block_list.name: Zephyr & Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Aaaayyyy." ..."Aaaayyyy"...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"My. Miracle's Trainer, you really know 
how to summon a favorable wind."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Still, oh that Miracle-san. Fufufu, I 
never imagined she would actually buy 
plain glasses.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The clerk recommended it to me, so I just 
kinda... But looking at Zephyr's, I 
probably bought the wrong thing... didn't 
I?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I was told to "get into character first 
and just ride the vibe"— and that this is 
the proper attire for a "party."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Still, well, the shape isn't all that 
different, and that too will surely bring 
fair winds. It suits you wonderfully, 
Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You think so? Thank you... You look like 
you're having a lot of fun too, Zephyr. 
It's lovely.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And what about yours, Trainer...? Wow, 
it's star-shaped!
choice_data_list:
Because I want to enjoy myself along the 
way!

Because I want to enjoy myself along the 
way!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see... Taking a breather is important 
for you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Let's all take the time to get 
plenty refreshed today."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had planned this more for K.S.Miracle to 
refresh herself rather than for myself, 
but there was no need to go out of my way 
to spell that out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, considering her personality, 
it might actually be easier for her to 
have fun if she frames it as 'helping the 
Trainer take a break.'"
choice_data_list:
(Anyway... let's let her take a break 
today!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we spent the rest of that day 
hanging out and having a blast with 
K.S.Miracle and Yamanin Zephyr...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Hehe, it's not every day you 
get to eat something so splendid.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Being told I could choose three made me 
hesitate a little. I felt just like 
drifting willow catkins...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Still, wondering what to pick is 
half the fun of this sort of thing—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and Trainer. I grabbed an extra spoon, 
so...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, want a bite of mine? 
...This cassis sorbet looks so good it's 
hard to make up your mind, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, it hit me. What she was 
holding was indeed the blackcurrant flavor 
that I had agonized over picking until the 
very end.
choice_data_list: Huh, did you pick this out for me?!
Huh, did you pick this out for me?!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, don't mention it. Seeing you 
agonizing over it just made me crave some 
too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So, it was truly delicious... and I wanted 
you to try it too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...How about it? If you'd like some 
before it melts."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Miracle... You had finally laid down 
to rest, are you getting back up already?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, well... Maybe it's because I 
rarely come to a resort like this, but I'm 
feeling a little nervous...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you feel hesitant even about 
basking in the sea breeze...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, shall I sing for you? 
...People often praise my singing, saying 
it's quite relaxing, actually."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
To my family, my classmates... and also to 
the various animals I often play with in 
the forest.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Is that so...! Amazing, as expected of 
Zephyr."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu. If you will allow me, then.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list:
(I-I feel like I'm going to fall 
asleep...!)

(I-I feel like I'm about to fall 
asleep...!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It looks like we somehow managed 
to make it in time for the fireworks.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Sorry to keep you waiting...! 
Changing clothes took a bit longer than I 
thought...
choice_data_list: No, I haven't been waiting at all.
No, I haven't been waiting at all.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: You think so? ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're wearing a jinbei too, Trainer... 
The designs are different, but the colors 
match. ...Fufu, that makes me a little 
happy.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, your yukata... And your hair 
looks different from usual, too. It makes 
you look mature and wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Miracle-san, Trainer. Look. Up 
there—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wah! ...So pretty...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching K.S. Miracle's profile 
illuminated by the colorful fireworks, I 
wonder to myself... Were they able to have 
fun? Were they able to rest—?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It truly felt like being caught right in 
the middle of a storm of cherry blossoms, 
didn't it? Now then, all that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't we browse the stalls for a bit? 
Let us surrender ourselves to this joyous 
divine presence."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Food stalls, huh...? Sounds good, let's 
go! Trainer, is there anything that 
catches your eye?
choice_data_list:
Maybe something food-related that'll give 
me some energy?
A game-type one that'll get us fired up!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Festival food is really appealing, isn't 
it? So much of it looks fun, and the smell 
too...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back. On nights when there was a 
festival nearby, the street in front of 
the hospital felt so lively... and from 
far, far away, you could smell the sauce."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Zephyr? ...What could be the 
matter...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for waiting. Here you are, 
Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wait, Zephyr? That's an insane 
amount, what on earth...!?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Therefore, let us smell plenty. And 
let us eat plenty. Together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Zephyr...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Yeah, let's do that. ...Thank 
you, Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After all, K.S. Miracle has a small 
appetite, so I had to put in quite a bit 
of effort myself... but somehow, the three 
of us managed to finish it all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, the next morning.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Games... like target shooting, or raffles? 
Hehe, all of them sound so fun, don't 
they?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... at the hospital 
where I play the piano, one of the kids I 
made friends with gave me a yo-yo as a 
present."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Looks like she didn't know it would 
deflate, so when she took it out and it 
got small, she started crying... But it 
made me really happy.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's completely dried up now, but I 
still keep it, even today.
choice_data_list:
Since we're here, shall we try the yo-yo 
fishing?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. And let's give them to each other.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to win one for you. 
Preferably in a color that looks great on 
you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Zephyr... Yeah, absolutely, 
please do.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what colors I should give the two 
of them. For Zephyr... sky blue? And for 
Trainer—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I gotta do my best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three of us had fun fishing 
for yo-yos and trading them...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, the next morning.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo——phew.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...Yesterday was really fun.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Still—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(It feels like I'm making them worry a 
lot. My Trainer... so very much.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Somehow... I have to tell them.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I have to somehow let them know I'm okay—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Zephyr! You're up early. ...Did I wake 
you when I headed out, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No. I was planning to get up anyway, in 
case you were heading out.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san. I have set the Sprinters 
Stakes as my goal.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I was forced to take a long hiatus, but... 
I am finally prepared to become a swift 
gale.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see...! So finally... We classmates can 
finally compete against each other.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...So you too, then?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course. I'm entering the 
Sprinters Stakes too. I'll enter, and I'll 
definitely win—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even while feeling fatigued and out of 
shape?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even if that body braving the storm is 
bruised and battered, slowly beginning to 
creak and groan?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You're... entering the race? ...Are you 
truly sure?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'll run.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for worrying about me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“It's okay, though. I already knew. From 
the very beginning—I knew.”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"It's thanks to the miracle everyone gave 
me that I'm finally able to run. But—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even miracles have their limits. They 
don't last forever and ever. ...That's why 
it has to be the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I will win there. There is no other 
option. ...I have nothing else."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry. I gotta go run. Catch you 
later, Zephyr."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san—
